Hobbies

When I'm not staring at code, you'll probably find me doing one of these. Achievement unlocked: you found the fun page!

Video Games

RPGs, MMOs and anything with a skill tree. Skyrim is my all-time favorite: I used to be a researcher like you, then I took an arrow in the knee.

Comics

Marvel fan through and through, with a soft spot for the X-Men. Still waiting for my mutant power to manifest (debugging at 3 a.m. probably counts).

Movies & TV Series

Fantasy all the way: The Lord of the Rings and Harry Potter are on permanent rewatch. One does not simply watch the extended editions just once.

Pizza

I make my own dough and bake pizza in every shape: round, in a pan and many other ways. Hydration levels are tracked more carefully than my experiments.

LEGO

Building things one colorful brick at a time. My proudest build is a huge Hogwarts Castle, which also works as a great excuse not to dust the shelf.

Travel

Exploring new places, new food and new cultures. Conferences are just side quests on the way to the next city.

Swimming

Competitive swimmer, both in the pool and in open water. Lap after lap, it's where I do my best thinking (and my best breathing exercises).
